project.title: Day-Night variation of indoor air metagenome
project.description: Day-Night variation of indoor air and the reference outdoor air metagenome to study the impact of indoor mold pollution and the ventilation system operation on bioaerosols dynamics.
project.center_name: Singapore Centre for Environmental Life Sciences Engineering (SCELSE)
